WITH exam_counts AS (
  SELECT ID, COUNT(*) as num_exams
  FROM Examination
  WHERE ID IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ID
),
total_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(num_exams) as total_exams,
    COUNT(*) as num_patients,
    1.0 / COUNT(*) as avg_share
  FROM exam_counts
)
SELECT 
  ec.ID,
  ec.num_exams,
  ec.num_exams * 1.0 / ts.total_exams as share,
  ec.num_exams * 1.0 / ts.total_exams - ts.avg_share as margin
FROM exam_counts ec, total_stats ts
WHERE ec.num_exams * 1.0 / ts.total_exams > ts.avg_share
ORDER BY margin DESC
LIMIT 10
